by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ s Q A B _ hAB _ _ hA hB
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := FiniteDimensional.of_fact_finrank_eq_two
  haveI : Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2) := ⟨Module.Basis.orientation (Module.finBasisOfFinrankEq ℝ V Fact.out)⟩
  have hQ : dist Q A = dist Q B := hA.dist_eq_of_mem_of_mem hB (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ Q A) (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ Q B)
  have hO : dist A s.center = dist B s.center := by
    rw [EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere.mp hA.mem_sphere, EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere.mp hB.mem_sphere]
  have hQ' : dist A Q = dist B Q := by rw [dist_comm A, dist_comm B]; exact hQ
  have h1 : inner ℝ (Q -ᵥ s.center) (B -ᵥ A) = 0 := EuclideanGeometry.inner_vsub_vsub_of_dist_eq_of_dist_eq hO hQ'
  refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
  have h2 : inner ℝ (midpoint ℝ A B -ᵥ s.center) (B -ᵥ A) = 0 := EuclideanGeometry.inner_vsub_vsub_of_dist_eq_of_dist_eq hO (dist_left_midpoint_eq_dist_right_midpoint A B)
  have hne : B -ᵥ A ≠ 0 := vsub_ne_zero.mpr hAB.symm
  have hOQ : Q ≠ s.center := by
    intro h
    have := hA.radius_lt_dist_center (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ Q A) ‹Q ≠ A›
    rw [h, dist_self] at this
    linarith
  let o : Orientation ℝ V (Fin 2) := Module.Oriented.positiveOrientation
  have r1 := (o.inner_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_smul_rotation_pi_div_two (x := B -ᵥ A) (y := Q -ᵥ s.center)).mp (by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact h1)
  have r2 := (o.inner_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_smul_rotation_pi_div_two (x := B -ᵥ A) (y := midpoint ℝ A B -ᵥ s.center)).mp (by rw [real_inner_comm]; exact h2)
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := r1.resolve_left hne
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := r2.resolve_left hne
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_smul] at ha
    exact hOQ (vsub_eq_zero_iff_eq.mp ha.symm)
  have : midpoint ℝ A B = AffineMap.lineMap Q s.center (1 - b / a) := by
    have e1 : midpoint ℝ A B -ᵥ Q = (midpoint ℝ A B -ᵥ s.center) - (Q -ᵥ s.center) := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right _ _ _).symm
    have e2 : s.center -ᵥ Q = -(Q -ᵥ s.center) := (neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev _ _).symm
    have e3 : (1 - b / a) * a = a - b := by field_simp
    rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, eq_vadd_iff_vsub_eq, e1, e2, ← hb, ← ha, smul_neg, smul_smul, e3]
    module
  rw [this]
  exact AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair _ _ _
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (s : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (Q A B : P), 0 < s.radius → A ≠ B → Q ≠ A → Q ≠ B → s.IsTangentAt A line[ℝ, Q, A] → s.IsTangentAt B line[ℝ, Q, B] → inner ℝ (Q -ᵥ s.center) (B -ᵥ A) = 0 ∧ midpoint ℝ A B ∈ line[ℝ, Q, s.center]
